name: Taquitos

ingredients.name: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Dice potatoes and boil in the measured water for 15 minutes until soft. Drain well and mash. Preheat oven to 220°C.
Mash black beans coarsely. Combine with potato, cheese, cumin, paprika and salt into a thick filling; cool until easy to handle.
Warm 12 small corn tortillas in a covered microwave-safe dish under a damp cloth for 40 seconds, until flexible. Divide filling along their centres and roll tightly into tubes.
Arrange seam-side down on a lined tray and brush all exposed surfaces with oil. Bake for 22 minutes, turning carefully halfway, until crisp and golden.
Mix sour cream with lime juice and chopped coriander. Serve taquitos hot with this dip in a separate bowl.
tips: Warm tortillas just before rolling to prevent cracking; keep waiting tortillas covered.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
